rows.en:
(I'm going to Central Park with
Yamashiro-sensei today!)

\p.
You're on time today.
Yes, I made a real effort.

Something this basic shouldn't take effort...
Now then, let's take a little walk.

A leisurely stroll once in a while
is a fine thing.
Yes, that felt great.

It shows you just how much we rush
through life day to day.

Still, it's also true that
we can't spend all our time resting.
Y-yeah, I guess so...

Well, time to head home.
You be careful on your way back, too.

(I'm going to Central Park with
Yamashiro-sensei today.)

(I'm going to Central Park with
Yamashiro-sensei again today!)

\p.
Here early, I see. Commendable.
Yes, it's all thanks to your guidance, Sensei!

Heh, it seems all my nagging
has finally paid off.
Now then, let's take a little walk.

This place is nice no matter
when you come.
Nature really is soothing, isn't it?

Though this is nature that was
built according to a plan...

But for us, we have no choice
but to think of this as nature.

(I'm going to Central Park with
Yamashiro-sensei again today.)

(I'm going to Folmo with
Yamashiro-sensei today!)
Took you long enough, \p.
rows.notes: The player answers that it is still 15 minutes early; the line is also replayed mid-scene in frd_itk_105 (script reuse). 'Took you long enough' fits the opening.

rows.en:
You're just too early, Sensei.
There's still 15 minutes to go...
Is that so?

Well, never mind.
Let's have a little look around.

The soft serve here is apparently famous.
Not that I've ever had it...

Really?
It's delicious. Why not try some?

I'll pass today.
I'll save it for next time.
Well then, shall we head back?

(I'm going to Folmo with
Yamashiro-sensei today.)

Whaaat! What a waste...
It's delicious. Why not try some?
But it's so good...

(I'm going to Folmo with
Yamashiro-sensei again today!)

\p, you're very early.
Arriving a full 15 minutes ahead...

...I was trying to get here
before you, Sensei...
Hahaha, too bad for you.
This soft serve is quite good...

Isn't it?
Apparently they use milk fresh from the udder.

I see.
It really brings out the milk's
natural sweetness.
Y-you can really tell, huh...

That was delicious.
Well then, shall we head back?

(I'm going to Folmo with
Yamashiro-sensei again today.)

(I came out for tea with
Yamashiro-sensei today, but...)
You're right on time, Sensei.

I meant to come early, but I had
a little errand to take care of...
Well then, let's go in.

I don't come to this cafe often,
but it's quite authentic.
It's aimed at students, though.

You really can't know until you taste it
yourself. One mustn't judge by
preconceptions or appearances...

Right, on to the next place.
Follow me.
H-hey, Sensei! Wait for me!!
(Today was a nice change of pace.)
(Today was a nice change of pace~)
I beat you here again today!

True. At this rate, I may not be
fit to be a teacher...
Ahaha. Well then, shall we go in?

I tried ordering something different today,
but can't they do something about
all those topping options?
D-don't ask me...

I'd think that makes the work
terribly inefficient...

Let's go find out whether
other shops are the same.
(I had a fun time with Sensei!)
I beat you here again today!
D-don't look at me...
(I had a great time with Sensei!)

uncertain: c06580 'Took you long enough, \p.': the player replies it is still 15 minutes early; the same line is replayed mid-scene several times in frd_itk_105 (script reuse), translated once.
c06582 'Is that so?' is shared with Klan (frd_kln_003, after the player says it does not feel like shopping together).
c06601 '(I came out for tea with Yamashiro-sensei today, but...)' opens both visits of frd_itk_106 in both genders; the trailing 'but' is kept as the Japanese trails off.
c06599: Yamashiro's gochisousama after soft-serve rendered 'That was delicious.' (not 'thanks for the meal', since nobody treated him).
